text:
sam: Quick syncconsole wants richer per-route attribution. Proposal: SDKs emit X-Route-Meta v2 as base64(json) + short v1 fallback. Thoughts on break risk and sampling?

joel: base64 gives us fields without header churn. Proxy header-size and stripping are real concerns though.

maria: Telemetry needs a `meta_source` tag: v2 | v1 | reconstructed. Also track decode_error counts.

nina: For Python, add a per-request hook so apps can compute dynamic priority. For TS/Go, opt-in flag + default=false.

alex: Example header wanted (before base64): `{"version":2,"policy":"weighted","priority":"gold","quota":"team-alpha"}`. SDKs should send both when opt-in=true.

joel: SDK API sketch: `new Redwood({key, routeMetaOptIn: true, routeMetaSampler: 0.01})` and `client.setRouteMeta(fn)` for per-request.

sam: Rollout plan: 1) SDKs add opt-in behind flag; 2) servers accept both and emit decode metrics; 3) console staging reads v2 and shows "beta route meta" banner + sampled badge; 4) opt-in internal canaries; 5) monitor, then GA.

maria: Also require sampling hint header: `X-Route-Meta-Sample: 0.01` so customers can limit volume. Console should annotate sampled rows.

joel: Tests: encode/decode roundtrip, fallback when v2 missing or invalid, header size regression. I'll add unit + e2e.

alex: Deploy note: start console tile in staging only. If decode_errors spike, rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy: console canary staging-console-7 started link: https://deploys.redwood/staging/console/7

sam: Action items: joel SDK PRs, nina server decode + metrics, maria telemetry dashboard, alex docs + customer comms. Follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30.

joel: I'll prepare code snippets for TS/Python/Go and a short migration guide.

sam: thanks tagging @here for visibility.
